carts_owner_present.name: carts_owner_present
carts_owner_present.value: "carts"."customer_id" is not null or "carts"."guest_token_hash" is not null

checkout_sessions_owner_present.name: checkout_sessions_owner_present
checkout_sessions_owner_present.value: "checkout_sessions"."customer_id" is not null or "checkout_sessions"."guest_token_hash" is not null

messages_sender_valid.name: messages_sender_valid
messages_sender_valid.value: ("messages"."sender_type" = 'seller' and "messages"."sender_user_id" is not null) or ("messages"."sender_type" = 'customer' and "messages"."sender_customer_id" is not null)

notifications_recipient_valid.name: notifications_recipient_valid
notifications_recipient_valid.value: ("notifications"."audience" = 'seller' and "notifications"."user_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."audience" = 'customer' and "notifications"."customer_id" is not null)

store_theme_publication_state_valid.name: store_theme_publication_state_valid
store_theme_publication_state_valid.value:
(
        ("store_theme_configurations"."lifecycle" = 'draft' and "store_theme_configurations"."published_version" is null and "store_theme_configurations"."published_at" is null)
        or
        ("store_theme_configurations"."lifecycle" in ('published', 'archived') and "store_theme_configurations"."published_version" > 0 and "store_theme_configurations"."published_at" is not null)
      )
